en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a small European town. A wide unpaved road runs through the center with children walking and a man riding a bicycle. On the left is a half‑timbered corner building signed as a confectionery and bakery; behind it stands a more ornate three‑story house with a mansard roof and a business sign over the entrance. Modest houses with gardens and wooden fences line both sides of the street. The clothing of the people and architectural style suggest an early 20th‑century German town.
